# "Profile" field, which controls profile location.
imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "Thunderbird", when=target_is_windows | target_is_osx)
imply_option("MOZ_APP_PROFILE", "thunderbird", when=~target_is_windows & ~target_is_osx)
